headline: Nigeria Digital Economy Faces Thousands of Weekly Cyberattacks
summary: Nigeria's digital economy faces growing cybersecurity risks as organizations experience an average of 4,361 attempted cyberattacks weekly.
why: Cybersecurity threats can disrupt digital infrastructure, increase compliance and operational costs, and impact investor confidence in emerging digital economies.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Widespread cyberattacks pose operational risks to the country's digital economy.
